Okay. This code is like when I tried to do many things at once and dropped my chili. Bad things happen.

## Race Conditions I Found

### 1. Fast Path Read Without Lock (Lines 44-49) - CRITICAL

```go
if entry, ok := c.data[key]; ok {  // No lock! Reading map!
```

**Interleaving:**
1. Goroutine A reads `c.data[key]` 
2. Goroutine B writes to `c.data` with lock
3. PANIC: concurrent map read/write

Me fix:
```go
c.mu.Lock()
entry, ok := c.data[key]
c.mu.Unlock()
```

### 2. Set() Has No Lock (Lines 99-104) - CRITICAL

```go
func (c *Cache) Set(key string, value interface{}) {
    c.data[key] = &CacheEntry{  // No lock! Map write!
```

Same panic. Need lock. Why no lock? Someone was lazy. Maybe me in past life.

### 3. Stats Updates Not Atomic (Lines 47, 56, 71, 76) - HIGH

```go
c.stats.Hits++  // Not atomic! Many goroutines incrementing!
```

Two goroutines read 5, both write 6. We lose count. Like when I count cookies but keep eating them.

Fix: Use `atomic.AddInt64(&c.stats.Hits, 1)`

### 4. cleanup() No Lock (Lines 129-140) - CRITICAL

```go
for key, entry := range c.data {  // Iterating without lock!
    delete(c.data, key)           // Deleting without lock!
```

This cause "concurrent map writes" panic. Need lock around whole loop.

### 5. waitForLoad() Reads Without Lock (Lines 93-95) - HIGH

```go
entry, ok := c.data[key]  // No lock! Could read partial write!
```

Could see half-written entry. Corrupted value. Bad.

### 6. GetMulti() Results Map Race (Lines 107-118) - CRITICAL

```go
results[k] = value  // Multiple goroutines writing same map!
```

Also, `time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)` is not waiting properly. Goroutines might not finish. Use `sync.WaitGroup`.

### 7. cleaning Flag Race (Lines 129-130) - MEDIUM

```go
if c.cleaning { return }
c.cleaning = true
```

Two cleanups could both see `false`, both start. Use atomic or put inside lock.

### 8. Refresh() No Lock (Lines 148-155) - CRITICAL

Same as Set(). Writing map without lock.

### 9. LoadOrStore() No Lock (Lines 158-173) - CRITICAL

Reading AND writing map without lock. Double bad.

## Summary

| Bug | Severity | Lines |
|-----|----------|-------|
| Fast path read | Critical | 44-49 |
| Set() no lock | Critical | 99-104 |
| cleanup() no lock | Critical | 129-140 |
| GetMulti() map race | Critical | 107-118 |
| Refresh() no lock | Critical | 148-155 |
| LoadOrStore() no lock | Critical | 158-173 |
| Stats not atomic | High | 47,56,71,76 |
| waitForLoad() read | High | 93-95 |
| cleaning flag race | Medium | 129-130 |

Main fix: Use `sync.RWMutex`. Read lock for reads. Write lock for writes. Atomic for counters.

It's done. I found them. Somehow. Many small bugs make big panic.
